description: Hand the analysis payment transaction to the server once it is mined. The server reads it on-chain: a direct USDC transfer (the USDC of the invoice network) from the invoice creator to the Vurto fee wallet, of at least analysis.amount, newer than the invoice, never used for another analysis or invoice. screening_blocked (403): the free screening rejects the receiving wallet or the creator, and the payment is not registered. analysis_payment_pending (409): not mined yet, call again in a few seconds. analysis_payment_rejected (400) with details.reason (wrong_token, wrong_destination, amount_too_low, sender_not_creator, not_a_transfer, tx_reverted, tx_before_invoice): that transaction does not pay this analysis. tx_already_used (409): the hash already paid something else. Once paid, analysis.status is paid and the invoice can be paid. On Solana (new model) pass payer too: the transaction must be signed by that payer and only the fee wallet may gain USDC in it (the split payment of an invoice never pays it, usdc_to_other_wallet); once paid the receiver analysis runs right away and receiverAnalysis.result comes back (verdict and the paid tools, never the receiving wallet).

payer.description: Solana (new model): the paying wallet that bought the receiver analysis.

txHash.description: EVM transaction hash, or the Solana signature, of the analysis payment.

name: invoice_report_analysis_payment
